report.title: Quarterly Business Report
report.author: Daniel Foster, VP Finance
report.summary: Q2 2026 delivered strong revenue growth at USD 18.4M, representing a 22% increase year-over-year. The Cloud Platform division led all segments with 38% growth, driven by enterprise adoption and a successful product launch in May. Operating margins improved to 31%, reflecting economies of scale and disciplined cost management. Customer retention remained strong at 94%, with NPS reaching 58.
report.regionAnalysis: Asia-Pacific and Middle East & Africa showed the strongest growth trajectories at 45% and 80% respectively, validating our international expansion strategy. North America remains the largest contributor at 40% of total revenue, with stable margins and a healthy pipeline. Europe continues to mature with improving margins, while Latin America is building momentum through channel partnerships.

conclusions.title: Revenue Momentum
conclusions.text: Q2 revenue of USD 18.4M represents the strongest quarter in company history. The Cloud Platform is our growth engine, and the upcoming launch of AI-powered features in Q3 is expected to further accelerate adoption among enterprise customers.

conclusions.title: International Expansion
conclusions.text: Our investment in the Asia-Pacific and MEA regions is ahead of plan. While margins are still developing, the growth rates and pipeline coverage justify continued investment. We plan to open a Singapore office in Q3.

conclusions.title: Operational Excellence
conclusions.text: The improvement in operating margin from 28.5% to 31% reflects successful automation initiatives and platform leverage. We remain on track for our full-year margin target of 32%.
